what: the half disc of radius 14 on the far side of a diameter 14 mm from the axis (the full circle would touch the axis: a horn torus) revolved 270 degrees
method: Pappus: the half disc (the side away from the axis) has area pi 14^2 / 2 and centroid at 14 + 4 * 14 / (3 pi) from the axis: V = (270/360) 2 pi (14 + 4*14/(3 pi)) pi 14^2 / 2 = 28932.2 (the design measures 28930.7).
